note: T-007-b: the Razzmatazz moment (MOTIVATION.md, CLAUDE.md §8). The group-lane loop prefixes the sender's display name, so the keyed text is "Dean: ..." and the tool list is every v0 tool except the DM-only get_my_pending_items. The model names the five members and excludes Henry; booking/proposals.ts stops at a BookingProposal, and the next round is answered by the offline tool_result_ack responder. packages/agent/src/loop.test.ts asserts this key matches deriveScriptKey of the real request.

lastUserText: Dean: @trav we're 6, flying BOS SFO ORD JFK LAX MIA into BCN thurs mar 12, home tues mar 17 to JFK LAX ORD IAD SEA ATL. find flights that land around the same time
note: T-074 (was T-021 step 2): the multi-origin flights ask in pnpm demo:barcelona. The model maps each member to the origin and return airport they said earlier in the chat (Dean BOS out, JFK back; Chase SFO/LAX; Piotr ORD both ways; Arjun JFK/IAD; Crowley LAX/SEA; Henry MIA/ATL) and calls search_flights in its group form: one provider search per traveler, flights.optimizeGroupFlights ranks whole-group itineraries (refundable first), and the options card is the terminal result the loop posts as is. "@trav book option 1" then goes through propose_booking kind flight.
